notes.title: The Panel DC version 1.02 release notes
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add an achievement for completing the game under 5 minutes.
[*] New sound slider to control the game volume.
[*] Add a system to display where the steam goes in the pipe puzzles section.
[*] Add a text reveal effect for intro and outro text.
[*] The timer is now always visible while playing the game.
[*] The Esc key now passes the intro and outro.
[*] The Enter key now proceeds to the next the intro and outro slide.
[*] Change the text and button position in intro and outro slides.
[*] The in-game button in the bottom right corner, now return to the menu instead of closing the game.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix the Steam achievements not always synchronizing.
[*] Fix inconsistent fonts around the game.
[*] The intro and outro music now loop.
[*] The flashlight now closes when the end-game animation play.
[*] Fix some typos.
[*] Many more small fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: The Panel DC version 1.01 release notes
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now, the logbook page numbers are always visible.
[*] When zoomed on the [i]Logbook[/i] or the [i]Floor Note[/i], clicking outside the logbook or note return to standard view/zoom.
[*] Allow returning to the game even with the 18 puzzles completed.
[*] The road six hint is now more visible.
[*] Update Unity version.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Logbook last pages did not have the right pages numbers.
[*] Wrong cursor change behaviours.
[*] The generator keeps killing player even if repaired.
[*] The timer numbers disappear after 6 minutes.
[/list]
